caveats_c3: C1 (build system maturity): tool/build_interp.hexa hardcodes a 120s timeout for hexa_v2 transpile, but the hexa_v2 self-host transpile of hexa_full.hexa (1.5MB flattened) takes ~200s on M-series. Workaround: run hexa_v2 manually with gtimeout 600 then re-invoke build_interp.hexa with SKIP_TRANSPILE=1. Long-term: bump the 120s default in tool/build_interp.hexa to 600s.

C2 (env var convention): The dispatch script ~/.hx/bin/hexa seeds HEXA_INTERP=/usr/local/bin/build/hexa_interp for the docker container, but resolve_interp() in self/main.hexa does NOT read $HEXA_INTERP — it relies on the 4th-tier hardcoded fallback to /usr/local/bin/build/hexa_interp. Adding $HEXA_INTERP env-var read would touch language runtime semantics and was deferred per task constraint 'DO NOT touch raw hexa-lang grammar; only build/dispatch infrastructure'. Symptom is hidden because the container default path matches the seeded env value.

C3 (cross-platform Mac arm64 vs x86_64): The rebuilt binary is arm64-only; x86_64 Mac (Intel) and Linux paths use separate cached binaries (hexa_interp_linux_x86_64, hexa_interp_linux_arm64) at build/. This rebuild did not touch those — they remain at their prior dates (Apr 26 / Apr 27). If x86_64 Mac runners exist, they need a separate cross-compile pass.
